preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= 2 * 10**5 for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges m is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t for s, t in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and 's' in line and 't' in line))
preconditions.description: For each test case, s and t are distinct vertices between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and not ('s' in line or 't' in line)))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == m for edges in (stdin.splitlines()[i:i+m] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 2) if i % 2 == 1))
preconditions.description: The number of edges provided matches m for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(stdout.strip()), int) for stdout in (line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.strip()) <= 10**9 + 6 for stdout in (line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.strip()) == count_paths(s, t, adj) for stdout, (n, m, s, t, adj) in zip((line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')), parse_input(stdin)))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the number of paths from s to t whose length differs from the shortest path length by no more than 1, modulo 10^9 + 7.
